title: The Lantern Keeper
story: On the stormiest night of the year, young lighthouse keeper Mira sees a tiny light blinking from the rocks. Though the beacon is fading, she carries her last lantern down the cliff. A stranded sailor follows its glow home; dawn finds the lighthouse dark, but the harbor is safe.
logline: A young lighthouse keeper risks her last light to guide a stranger home through a storm.
characters: Mira — young keeper, indigo coat, short dark hair; kind, steady voice. Sailor — small silhouette in a yellow rain cape; no dialogue.
palette: Midnight blue, warm amber, paper ivory
voice_plan: Narrator: intimate, warm, measured English voice. Mira: no spoken dialogue; let the gesture carry the emotion.
music_notes: Low cello and soft rain texture; one warm bell as the sailor reaches the harbor; resolve into a gentle sustained chord.
rights_note: Original procedural preview artwork. Replace or supplement with owned artwork for production.

scenes.title: The fading beacon
scenes.action: Mira watches a lighthouse beam falter above a stormy sea. A distant light blinks twice among the rocks.
scenes.narration: On the stormiest night of the year, Mira saw a light where no light should be.
scenes.sound: Rain and wind; two distant bell-like pings. Let the second blink hang in silence.

scenes.title: One last flame
scenes.action: Mira shields her small amber lantern and carefully descends the cliff path toward the stranded sailor.
scenes.narration: The great beacon was failing. Mira carried the only flame she had left.
scenes.dialogue: Mira, softly: Hold on. I can see you.
scenes.sound: Footsteps on wet stone; music begins with a low cello pulse.

scenes.title: A harbor at dawn
scenes.action: The sailor reaches the harbor. Dawn warms the horizon as Mira and the safe boat become small beneath the lighthouse.
scenes.narration: By morning the light had gone out. But every boat had found its way home.
scenes.sound: Rain falls away; soft gulls, one bell, warm resolved chord; leave two seconds of quiet.
